name: Oppaidius: Tropical Cruise!
source:
When your friend Jimmy gave you a ticket for a cruise, at first you were almost dubious... then, after getting on the ship, you were quite happy to have listened to him!

Angela, the singer, seemed like she came right out of a dream, and when you met her, nothing was going to be like the way it was before...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179100/Oppaidius_Tropical_Cruise/]Steam[/url]]
